```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Basic Radar Charts

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scatterpolar(
    r = c(39, 28, 8, 7, 28, 39),
    theta = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "A"),
    fill = "toself"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    polar = go_polar(
      radialaxis = go_polar_radialaxis(visible = TRUE, range = c(0, 50))
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

#### Multiple Trace Radar Charts

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

go_figure() |>
  add_scatterpolar(
    r = c(39, 28, 8, 7, 28, 39),
    theta = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "A"),
    fill = "toself",
    name = "Group A"
  ) |>
  add_scatterpolar(
    r = c(1.5, 10, 39, 31, 15, 1.5),
    theta = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "A"),
    fill = "toself",
    name = "Group B"
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    polar = go_polar(
      radialaxis = go_polar_radialaxis(visible = TRUE, range = c(0, 50))
    )
  )
```

#### Reference

See `go_scatterpolar()` for more information and options!
